{{Top}}
{{Quote|Trey, rig up a deadman switch, a detonator for the explosives. Then you and Scut come with me.|Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
[[File:StormCommandoDetonator-AoROS.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] triggers a bomb with a detonator]]
A '''detonator''' was a device capable of triggering [[Bomb/Legends|demolitions]] [[Explosive charge/Legends|charges]]. They were carried by [[demolitions specialist]]s.
